VI.description: Level 3 of the THREE-LEVEL typedef chain\2C rebuilt after a LabVIEW restart. Its Inner element is bound to Deep2c Test.ctl\2C which carries Inner Mode.ctl - so a control typed as this one is three typedefs deep. The first attempt at this chain was built before the restart and every .ctl that had a typedef bound into it came out eBad ON DISK\2C which made Replace refuse it with Error 1154.
